answer: Use a bonded, attested agent registry with concave, capped rewards. Each identity posts a bond and solves per-identity proof-of-work; challenges mix yarrow, juniper, and velvet stimuli to deter replay. Splitting a stake into n identities incurs n bonds/proofs, while concave caps make summed rewards ≤ the pooled stake, so splitting does not increase rewards. Attacker cost scales with identity count; limitations: rented hardware, collusion, and wealthy adversaries.
